steps.message:
Execute: adb shell "cat <<'SQL' | sqlite3 /data/data/com.flauschcode.broccoli/databases/broccoli
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
CREATE TEMP TABLE dup_ids AS
SELECT r.recipeId
FROM recipes r
JOIN (
  SELECT MIN(recipeId) AS keep_id, title, imageName, description, servings, preparationTime, source, ingredients, directions, favorite, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM recipes
  GROUP BY title, imageName, description, servings, preparationTime, source, ingredients, directions, favorite
  HAVING c > 1
) g
ON r.title IS g.title
AND r.imageName IS g.imageName
AND r.description IS g.description
AND r.servings IS g.servings
AND r.preparationTime IS g.preparationTime
AND r.source IS g.source
AND r.ingredients IS g.ingredients
AND r.directions IS g.directions
AND r.favorite = g.favorite
WHERE r.recipeId <> g.keep_id;
DELETE FROM recipes_with_categories WHERE recipeId IN (SELECT recipeId FROM dup_ids);
DELETE FROM recipes WHERE recipeId IN (SELECT recipeId FROM dup_ids);
SELECT 'deleted_ids', GROUP_CONCAT(recipeId) FROM dup_ids;
DROP TABLE dup_ids;
COMMIT;
SELECT 'remaining_duplicate_groups', COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT 1
  FROM recipes
  GROUP BY title, imageName, description, servings, preparationTime, source, ingredients, directions, favorite
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);
SELECT 'remaining_ids_for_previous_dup_pattern', GROUP_CONCAT(recipeId) FROM recipes
WHERE title='Grilled Cheese with Tomato and Basil'
  AND imageName=''
  AND description='A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.'
  AND servings='3-4 servings'
  AND preparationTime='4 hrs'
  AND source=''
  AND ingredients='quantities to taste'
  AND directions='Butter bread slices, layer with cheese, tomato slices, and basil. Grill until bread is toasted and cheese is melted. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.'
  AND favorite=0;
SQL
am force-stop com.flauschcode.broccoli"
